name: Hammer Pace
description: Plant the feet a shoulder apart and lock the pistol arm straight so the body sits solid behind the barrel.

name: Sudden Barrel
description: Seat the pistol butt deep in the web of the thumb and fire a ball along the line of the forearm.

name: Narrow Triggerbar
description: Hold the front sight steady on the foe's chest and squeeze off one aimed ball at close quarters.

name: Blunt Lanyardring
description: Bring the pistol up from the hip in one rising arc and fire the instant the arm locks level.

name: Hammerwedge
description: Rap the flat of the iron barrel against an incoming forearm or blade to turn it off the body line.

name: Firm Quickdraw
description: Reverse the emptied pistol and drive its heavy butt into the jaw of a foe who has closed in.

name: Pistolhit
description: Tear the paper cartridge with the teeth, pour the powder down the barrel and ready the pistol for its first shot.

name: Open Foresight
description: Drive the ball home with two firm ramrod strokes so the charge sits tight and the shot flies true.

name: Firm Report
description: Prime the pan from the horn, snap the cover shut and tap the lock plate so the spark will catch.

name: Muzzlepace
description: Carry the hammer at half cock while moving between points so the loaded pistol never fires by accident.

name: Barrelcount
description: Probe the touch hole with the priming wire to learn whether the vent is clear before the shot.

name: Hammercowl
description: Turn the shoulder to keep the powder pouch shielded from rain or a hostile grab.

name: Quick Cylinder
description: After a flash in the pan, wipe it clean, reprime and fire again without lowering the barrel from the foe.

name: Frizzen Strike
description: Pull the pistol from the belt sash in one clean motion and level it at the foe.

name: Muzzleblow
description: Reach across the chest for the butt, sweep the pistol free and fire along the swing of the arm.

name: Gnawing Hipshot
description: Fire from the hip without raising the sight, trading accuracy for speed against a foe within arm's reach.

name: Stepping Muzzle
description: Slide one foot off the line of the foe's lunge as the pistol hand clears the sash.

name: Soft Cylinder
description: Flip the holster flap and feel the butt with the thumb, confirming the grip before the eyes leave the foe.

name: Square Flashpan
description: Hold the loaded pistol out at arm's length until the wrist stops trembling, then fire one steady ball.

name: Square Lanyardring
description: Lock the wrist against the forearm tendons so the recoil lifts the barrel straight and no further.

name: Gnawing Pointblank
description: Let the barrel kick up, roll the wrist back down and re-aim in a single breath.

name: Muzzlegauge
description: Balance a cup of water on the barrel while aiming, training the wrist to feel its own tremor.

name: Firm Thumbback
description: Let the hammer fall on an empty pan again and again until the shot breaks without a flinch.

name: Gnawing Triggerbar
description: Swing the muzzle across to a second foe with only the wrist and fire before the arm follows.

name: Muzzlehusk
description: Stiffen the wrist and catch a descending cudgel on the iron barrel, turning it aside.

name: Blunt Muzzle
description: Thumb the hammer back to full cock with a slow ease so the lock never clicks loudly.

name: Gnawing Flashpan
description: Press the muzzle to the foe's side and fire, where no aim is needed and the ball cannot miss.

name: Blunt Thumbback
description: Shove the muzzle into the foe's throat to break his breath and open his guard.

name: Locking Pistolgrip
description: Seize the foe's weapon wrist with the free hand and fire past his shoulder while he struggles.

name: Pistolstrike
description: Pivot inside a clinch and fire the ball down along the foe's flank.

name: Snapfire Hop
description: Step through the cloud of powder smoke left by the shot to come at the foe from a new angle.

name: Barrelstay
description: Crouch behind the extended pistol arm and use the iron barrel to cover the face from a blow.

name: Barrelbump
description: Send a thread of qi to the flash pan so the spark catches cleanly even in damp air.

name: Descending Hammer
description: Time the hammer's fall to the exhale and fire as the qi circulates down the arm.

name: Hooding Frizzen
description: Use the iron pan cover and lock plate to catch and turn a thrown knife.

name: Reportdrop
description: Fire into the ground beside a foe so the flash and report halt his rush.

name: Watching Barrel
description: Wipe the lock plate dry and read through the clean click how well the spring sits.

name: Stepping Foresight
description: Glide forward with the hammer cocked, keeping the barrel level while the feet shift.

name: Pulling Pointblank
description: Burn a pinch of loose powder in the pan to flash across the eyes and spoil the foe's aim.

name: Reportbump
description: Bring the pistol up on a flat line from the belt, the barrel never dipping or climbing, and fire.

name: Leaden Quickdraw
description: Square the shoulder to the mark and hold the sight on it while qi settles the arm.

name: Flat Snapfire
description: Feel the barrel sag and lift it with a pulse of qi in the forearm before the shot breaks.

name: Triggerbar Review
description: Rest the cheek lightly on the raised arm and read the sight line through the bone.

name: Upward Report
description: Swing the barrel ahead of a moving foe and fire as the lead settles.

name: Leaden Snapfire
description: Thumb a paper cartridge from the belt pouch while the eyes stay on the foe.

name: Narrow Lanyardring
description: Hold the muzzle skyward and pour the measured powder in one steady stream, never looking down.

name: Pistoldrop
description: Run the ramrod down with a short swab stroke that seats the ball and clears the barrel of fouling.

name: Downward Frizzen
description: Draw a second loaded pistol from the sash and fire it as the first falls empty.

name: Settled Pistolgrip
description: Lean the shoulder against a pillar while the hands finish loading, keeping the body narrow to the foe's shot.

name: Muzzlewedge
description: Swing the weighted powder horn on its cord to knock aside a thrown dart or short blade.

name: Gnawing Muzzle
description: Warm damp powder in the palm with a breath of qi so it burns hot and true in the pan.

name: Easing Hammer
description: Shuffle one step off the foe's line with every ramrod stroke so he never has a still target.

name: Open Hipshot
description: Flip the pistol to the barrel and hook the heavy butt into the side of a foe's knee.

name: Forward Pistolgrip
description: Tap the butt cap sharply on the temple to daze a foe without killing him.

name: Planted Cylinder
description: Hold the iron barrel along the forearm and meet a sword cut on the metal.

name: Hammerstrike
description: Pour a thin qi into the pistol butt and chop it down onto a collarbone.

name: Level Quickdraw
description: Draw the pistol on a backhand arc so the butt lands on a foe's wrist before it ever points.

name: Descending Report
description: Roll the pistol from club grip to firing grip in one turn and fire at the foe staggering back.

name: Hipshot Bump
description: Rest the pistol arm on the edge of a low wall and take one slow aimed shot over it.

name: Barrelhit
description: Lean out past a corner for one breath, fire a snap shot and drop back behind the stone.

name: Foresight Pause
description: Kick a table onto its edge and crouch behind it as a rough screen against shot.

name: Pistoltrot
description: Hop from one cover to the next at a crouch, the pistol held ready against the chest.

name: Straight Thumbback
description: Fire blind over cover through the drifting smoke to pin a foe's head down.

name: Hammerdash
description: Pivot the shoulder around a doorframe so the barrel swings clear a heartbeat before the body.

name: Tending Cylinder
description: Hold still behind cover and listen for the foe's boots, the scrape of a lock cocking, the held breath.

name: Narrow Snapfire
description: Draw both pistols together from the belt and level them at two separate marks.

name: Swift Flashpan
description: Let the empty first pistol fall and bring the second into the hand already cocked.

name: Muzzle Pause
description: Cross the two pistol arms before the face so the iron barrels take the blow.

name: Hard Triggerbar
description: Retreat a step as both pistols fire in quick turn, one ball aimed high and one low.

name: Reportblow
description: Sweep the two muzzles across a doorway, firing in turn to keep it closed to all comers.

name: Reportcowl
description: Toss the empty pistol at the foe's face and catch the loaded one in the same moment.
